package.name: l5_park
package.description: L5 sim-in-loop canary for park_node (roadmap 2.9, claude-docs/12-testing.md): runs racer_gym_bridge with a walled corridor that has a pocket cut into its right wall, the car's LiDAR geometry (360 degrees, mounted facing backwards 0.285 m ahead of the rear axle), /odom/wheel synthesised from the sim's speed, racer_safety's safety_node in the loop and racer_control's park_node with its floor-2026-10-07 profile, and asserts the car finds the pocket and parks in it: parallel within 3 degrees, inside the pocket, no contact. Same shape as tests/l5_reactive_lap (whose helper module it reuses); no library code of its own.
